description: Defines data structures, enums, and constants related to PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) formats 0 to 4, including resource configurations and scheduler outputs for 5G NR specifications.

classes.name: pucch_resources
classes.description: Represents PRB and symbol ranges used for PUCCH resources, including second hop PRBs.

classes.name: pucch_format_0
classes.description: Contains scheduler output parameters for PUCCH Format 0, including group hopping and ID.

classes.name: pucch_format_1
classes.description: Contains scheduler output parameters for PUCCH Format 1, including group hopping, ID, timing, and slot repetition.

classes.name: pucch_format_2
classes.description: Contains scheduler output parameters for PUCCH Format 2, including scrambling IDs and code rate.

classes.name: pucch_format_3
classes.description: Contains scheduler output parameters for PUCCH Format 3, including hopping, scrambling, DMRS, and repetition.

classes.name: pucch_format_4
classes.description: Contains scheduler output parameters for PUCCH Format 4, including hopping, scrambling, DMRS, orthogonal sequence index, and spreading factor.
